selector.rationale: The presence of a well-defined mass in the diploic space with sparse but preserved trabeculae and a slight bony bulge is more characteristic of Hemangioma of bone, which typically presents with these radiological features.

rejected.label: Osteoma
rejected.why: Osteoma is typically a well-defined, dense, and compact bone lesion, which does not match the described radiological features of the lesion.

rejected.label: Lipoma
rejected.why: Lipoma would typically show high signal intensity on T1-weighted images due to fat content, which is not the primary characteristic of the lesion described.

rejected.label: intraosseous metaplastic meningioma
rejected.why: While some features are compatible, the specific radiological characteristics and location are more suggestive of Hemangioma of bone.
